L70: One of the 8 similar places (from my list) serving native Bangalore breakfast for years. All these 8 places have similar menus, similar ambiance and feel, all their dishes taste similar, and even their service was similar (commendable).
L71: So, to start with was the usual Idly & Vada - Well, what to say, no matter what time I visit, it tastes the same all the time; spongy idli while the vada was crispy without much oil to it 😚😚 Plain and Masala dosa - The only thing which a non-native person would complain about is the buttery affair making the hands greasy from their rich ghee and butter; so damn smooth while hot and crispy on the outside; well cooked on the inside with aloo gravy in it; their green chutney is the perfect icing on the dosa ❤️ Yet another Kharabath and Kesaribath - Maybe some of the hotels are in a common WhatsApp group since they served the same Jackfruit Kesari here too similar to the Arogya ahaara earlier that day.
L72: Nevertheless, it tasted the same and was good from the raisins 🥰🥰 The Kharabath had fewer veggies but the flavor from the onion and the chillies was kicky 🤩 To end up with, always go for coffee in Bangalore when in doubt. L73: Similar ambiance as the other tiffin spots (maybe the same designer for all places) so TBH didn't find any difference, even when it came to price. Pocket-friendly places of Bangalore.
